WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT
        web_returns.wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        customer_address.ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(web_returns.wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns
    JOIN date_dim ON web_returns.wr_returned_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON web_returns.wr_returning_addr_sk = customer_address.ca_address_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY web_returns.wr_returning_customer_sk, customer_address.ca_state
),
state_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ctr_state,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_ctr_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
),
ar_customer AS (
    SELECT customer.c_customer_sk
    FROM customer
    JOIN customer_address ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = customer.c_current_addr_sk
    WHERE customer_address.ca_state = 'AR'
),
customer_total_return_ar AS (
    SELECT
        customer_total_return.ctr_customer_sk,
        customer_total_return.ctr_state,
        customer_total_return.ctr_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    JOIN ar_customer ON ar_customer.c_customer_sk = customer_total_return.ctr_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    customer.c_customer_id,
    customer.c_salutation,
    customer.c_first_name,
    customer.c_last_name,
    customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    customer.c_birth_day,
    customer.c_birth_month,
    customer.c_birth_year,
    customer.c_birth_country,
    customer.c_login,
    customer.c_email_address,
    customer.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return_ar AS ctr1
JOIN state_avg ON state_avg.ctr_state = ctr1.ctr_state
JOIN customer ON customer.c_customer_sk = ctr1.ctr_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address ON customer_address.ca_address_sk = customer.c_current_addr_sk
WHERE customer_address.ca_state = 'AR'
  AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_ctr_total_return
ORDER BY
    customer.c_customer_id,
    customer.c_salutation,
    customer.c_first_name,
    customer.c_last_name,
    customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    customer.c_birth_day,
    customer.c_birth_month,
    customer.c_birth_year,
    customer.c_birth_country,
    customer.c_login,
    customer.c_email_address,
    customer.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
